'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Alexander Kennedy DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alexander Kennedy]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Bring Him Before Mess
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
